Das Haus wirkte sehr gemütlich und sauber. Auch wurde ich herzlich empfangen und bekam dazu auch noch gleich ein paar Tipps, wie ich am besten in die Altstadt komme und was ich mir unbedingt anschauen sollte. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist meiner Meinung nach äußerst gut. :)
Affordable bed in Porto, close to the metro. Nuno welcomed me after arriving late at night, he seemed like a sympathetic guy.

I wanted to see how the e-house worked and was set up.  It was a great experience having the elevated IKEA bed in a small room. Room is better than picture with a desk under the bed. The simple, efficient room worked well for keeping my stuff. Kitchen was well equipped. Host was very clear in communication and available for questions. I will go back and recommend e-houses when you need a room in Porto.

Buona accoglienza e disponibilità del proprietario. Nuno fa il possibile per venire in contro alle esigenze degli ospiti. La casa è grande e accogliente anche se purtroppo è ubicata praticamente su una sorta di circonvallazione con traffico sostenuto anche di notte e quindi molto rumorosa.  Per il resto tutto come da descrizione.
Der Gastgeber war hilfsbereit und nett. Das Zimmer war klein, aber fein und so, wie ich es mir vorgestellt hatte. Der einzige Nachteil war der Verkehrslärm.
Excelente atención, Nuno el afitrión excelente disposición, el servicio de la casa muy bueno, recomiendo ir el fin de semana ya que el metro funciona las 24 hrs. Recomendable y mucho.

Nice and clean place, a bit far away from the city but there is a metro station 5 minutes away. I walked most of the time from the city and to the city and was a nice walk. On the way many things to explore.
Perfect house with big spaces and not far from center! Everything was perfect! Just a bit noisy because it is close to the motorway! Very frienly staff and guest! Love it!

Très bonne position géographique de l'appartement : 2 min à pieds de Copacabana 
Immeuble sécurisé par la présence d'un gardien 
Appartement très agréable. Nous avons été très bien accueillies, Maria nous a beaucoup aidé lors de notre séjour. 
La convivialité de Maria fut extraordinaire et nous a permis de vraiment apprécier notre séjour à Rio.
Finalmente no pude hacer uso de la reserva. Pero realizamos el pago. María fue muy amable durante todo el proceso.
Adorei ficar com Maria. Ela é muito boa e atenciosa. Sempre deu dicas pra nós. Seu café da manha é gostoso :) Vou recomendar ela sempre. Obrigada Maria, foi muito gentil connosco.

Maria was very welcoming. She had a very motherly vibe which was good for two girls in a big city during the craziest time of year. She provided breakfast for us which was unexpected but very appreciated! The only thing I noticed was misleading was that there was no AC units in the apartment we just had fans to use. Also one thing to note is that there are 3 bedrooms in the apartment that are also being rented out on AirBnB. So other travelers may be staying there too. It may  not be the best for someone who needs a lot of privacy. 

The apartment was very clean and well kept which was a plus. The location was also great! Literally about 3 blocks from the beach. The staff in the building were also very nice and welcoming to us.

On a été très bien accueilli par Maria, elle nous a offert la meilleur de ses chambres! Disponible et d'une grande gentillesse, elle nous mis 
à notre à aise pendant tous notre séjour. Son appartement est la localisation idéale pour visiter les incontournables de Rio!
On serait bien resté plus longtemps. Merci Maria!

Minha hospedagem foi muito tranquila e agradável. A Maria é uma pessoa muito educada e atenciosa, além de te deixar muito à vontade. Costuma dar dicas de como se locomover pela região, alertando quanto aos possíveis contratempos. Serve também um delicioso café da manhã. A localização do apartamento é excelente, pois fica próximo da praia, como também do metrô, possibilitando uma fácil locomoção.

Todo muy bien! Maria es muy buena persona y preocupada. Ofrece un muy buen desayuno e intenta que esten lo mas comodos posibles. Todo igual a la descripción y salió todo perfecto. //
Tudo muito bem! Maria é muito boa pessoa e preocupada. Ela oferece um muito bom cafe de manha e tentar que são tão confortável possível. Tudo igual à descrição e tudo foi perfeito.
Muy buena anfitriona, nos oriento y guió en nuestra estadía por Rio. Muy recomendada
Lugar maravilhoso... Dona Maria sempre atenciosa te deixando bem a vontade e disponível para te ajudar/auxiliar no que precisar. Café da manhã maravilhoso e boas dicas!!!

María nos atendió de la mejor manera y fue muy hospitalaria con nosotras. Nos recomendaba sitios a donde ir y los cuidados que debíamos de tener por las fechas de Año Nuevo en la ciudad ya que puede ser algo peligrosa. Estuvimos muy a gusto en su casa y nos sentimos muy contentas de que alguien tan buena persona como Maria nos haya acogido. Se notaba el esmero que le ponía a detalles como la preparación del desayuno desde temprano. El espacio donde estuvimos tenía lo necesario para sentirnos cómodas y estar tranquilas. Su casa tenía una buenísima ubicación, tan solo a 3 cuadras de la playa.
Muchas gracias por todas tus atenciones, María! :)
Cabe destacar la atención de Maria, es una persona muy agradable, atenta y que todo el tiempo te hace sentir comoda. La ubicación del apart es muy buena. El hospedaje es muy confortable.

Adorei me hospedar na casa da Sra. Maria! Ela é uma pessoa super simpática e atenciosa.
O apartamento é super bem localizado, no coração de Copacabana,  limpo, bem decorado e  fica em um prédio muito seguro com porteiros hiper simpáticos. Recomendo e em outras oportunidades quero voltar a me hospedar com essa excelente anfitriã.

o quarto que a gente alugou tava um pouco pequeno mas brilhante de limpo, tudo é muito limpio (ela é muito estreita com a limpeza assim tudo ficam bem legal), María é muito atenta, generosa e até deu café de manhã pra gente, o apartamento muito bem locali

O apartamento do Armando é lindo, muito bem localizado e super bem equipado. Não senti falta de nada e foi muito confortável estar a duas quadras do posto 8 em ipanema. 
O Armando é uma pessoa muito fácil de lidar, não tive nenhum problema com ele nem com a hospedagem. Ele é muito disponível e tudo foi resolvido facilmente. 
A porta com fechadura digital traz comodidade pra gente não precisar carregar chave e também nem precisamos nos encontrar pessoalmente para isso. 
A varanda com churrasqueira e ducha também foram um plus, um ambiente muito gostoso prum dia em que a família chegou bem cansada!

Eu e meus amigos alugamos o Ap do Armando durante um final de semana e estava tudo perfeito. O apartamento é muito confortável, com tudo que se precisa, a área externa é ótima e a localização está próxima de tudo. O Armando foi muito atencioso e solícito com tudo. Todos adoraram.
Ótimo apartamento, todo decorado, com wifi, varanda grande. Armando sempre disponível para ajudar. Recomendo!

Todo cierto!  Espectacular departamento! Ubicación ideal, cerca de todo, tiene un equipamiento de primera y todo funciona bien. Armando estuvo siempre pendiente y atento a cualquier necesidad. Pasamos 10 dias muy cómodos y confortables. La seguridad de guardia 24 horas da mucha tranquilidad. Todo genial! Aparte, como siempre, Brasil y su gente nos trató muy, pero muy bien! Atentos, amables, educados y correctos (y muy divertidos)

El departamento esta muy bien ubicado. Y tiene un balcon divino.
Pero el departamento es para 5 personas, tiene solo un dormitorio grande con dos camas matrimoniales y despues un cuarto muyyyyy chico con una cama individual.
La comunicacion con armando fue muy buena y la predisposicion para arreglar el problema ya que me confirmo que entrabamos 9 personas por como dice la publicacion. 
Sacando de lado eso, que se soluciono trayendo colchones, lo demas bien

Everything was wonderful, I highly recommend this place. 
It's one block from the beach and near supermarkets, drug stores, atms, stores, bars, etc. Very convenient! Armando was always available to answer questions, very thoughtful throughout the whole booking process and also when we were there and after we left. The apartment is lovely, everything is new and clean!
Muito bom! Otima localizaçao e o proprietario nos recebeu mto bem
El departamento es muy lindo y cómodo. Un poco chico para 10 personas y no se puede hacer mucho ruido, más allá de eso todo genial.
Apartamento bem espaçoso, muito limpo e arrumado. Utensílios domésticos de última geração, com uma varanda muito agradável.
Apartamento top e muito bem decorado com uma área externa espaçosa e aconchegante. Anfitrião super atencioso. Voltarei com certeza !

O Armando é super atencioso, prestativo e simpático...amamos o apartamento, tem uma localização( do lado do metro, praia e com restaurantes, supermercados no mesmo quarteirão) e infra estrutura (imóveis modernos e bem cuidados) maravilhosa...sem contar a varanda com churrasqueira que faz toda a (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza voltaremos mais vezes.

Fantastic apartment in an amazing location. Armando couldn't have been a kinder host. I stupidly left my wallet (with a sizeable amount of money) behind, and he went above and beyond to return it to me. Top marks, top host!
Excelente hospitalidad por parte de Armando. Muy buen departamento, muy moderno y comodo

Yves was an amazingly helpful, organized and very welcoming host. He had left some food and refreshments for us and made sure we felt free to use his kitchen appliances and TV to make our stay comfortable. The central location made it easy to move around and enjoy the city. Yves' condo was exactly the same as shown in pictures.

I enjoyed my stay in Yves's house. This cozy place is very close to downtown. So, it's very convenient to go everywhere by Metro or bike if you wants to visit this beautiful city. The host is very sweet and nice, he is always accommodating to your needs. Bedrooms and bathroom are very clean;  shampoo, body wash, towels, etc. were all provided! Overall, great experience and I would highly recommend staying here.
Yves was a great host very welcoming, his place was great and described accurately as read online

Yves place was exactly like the pictures, beautiful, perfect location and we felt right at home. Although we did not meet Yves, Michel, Yves friend was really nice and welcoming, communication was very easy

Yves is a very accommodating host. We arrived later than we had expected due to some unforeseen bus troubles and Yves was very understanding about the whole ordeal. 
He was also extremely helpful, he provided recommendations for the best ways to get around the city, and informed us about free Bixi bike day. 
His condo was very clean, and he provided all of the accommodations we would ever need. 
He was also great at getting back to me right away - my messages were always answered within a few hours, and he answered all of my questions! 
I would highly recommend Yves' condo if you're planning to stay in this part of Montreal. It's a great location - it's so easy to get around the city with this condo as your home base!

Highly recommend this listing for a perfect place to stay in Montreal. The place is even better in reality than the pictures if you can believe it. Stayed with two other friends for a long weekend and had plenty of space to feel comfortable - honestly it was hard to leave sometimes, the place was so beautiful. Convenient location to get around Montreal and great neighborhood.

Unfortunately we didn't get to meet Yves, but he was the perfect host regardless. We had everything we could possibly need but he was still very communicative and friendly about making ourselves at home in his place. 

Overall would definitely stay here again - and probably will since I visit Montreal often!!

I just returned from five nights in Yves' apartment, and I can't say enough great things about my experience. The space is spectacular: bright, beautifully decorated, modern yet comfortable, and spotless. The sunken living room is an awesome place to hang out, the bedrooms are spacious, the outdoor area is a great place to relax with a cup of coffee in the morning under the trees. The apartment is in a fantastic neighborhood that has a real French flavor. It's within walking distance to many of Montreal's attractions, and a short metro ride to others. And Yves himself is the consummate host. He was friendly and gracious, was very flexible with our schedule, and checked in on us several times to make sure that we had everything we needed. This is a true Airbnb winner and I can't wait to return!

We had a five star experience during our two nights Yves' condo  at. The apartment is bright, beautiful and spacious. There are plenty of restaurants nearby and the metro is a short walk so it is very convenient. Yves was out of town when we arrived but he had someone meet us at the apartment to show us around. He was flexible to accommodate our late arrival. We came for the Montreal marathon, but I would like to come back, stay in Yves' apartment again and explore this beautiful city.
Amazing welcoming and amazing support during the stay. I will definitely miss such a nice people. House is super nice too, with the nice terrace.
Amazing stay. Perfect location. And the terrace really pays of with the amazing view. And the welcoming could not be better. Thank you so much.
Boa pequenino e confortável. Próximo a avenida principal.

This is a little hostel with double rooms. It was clean and we could find everything we needed. The house is 5 min walk from the "General Torres" metro station, which is the second station after São Bento. Our room was a bit too little and as it says in the description, it doesn't have any window, which is a little uncomfortable in summer. However, as I said, the description has those details. We arrived too late and didn't get to meet any of the hosts, but André was very kind writing us about what we could need and so on. Thanks for the hospitality!

The place is great. André checked us in and was very friendly, told us about all the places and activities to see/do while in Porto! We would recommend everyone to go there and enjoy Porto as much as possible!
Thanks André!
Le logement est propre, fonctionnel et très bien situé. La chambre est petite et sans fenêtre mais conforme à la description. Très bon accueil à l'arrivée. Merci André et Paulo !
Everything went good! The house was clean and had averything you Need. The room is really small and without any windows but for short staying it's okay.
It was nice to stay there. Small bedroom with no windows but very clean. 10 minutes walk to the center. The host gave us very good advices

it was great to stay there, Andre was there to help us and explain and recommend what to do, the best place to visit and the best food in Porto. the house was clean and not too far from central station. Very recommended!
Really nice localisation, not far to the city centre by foot. Andrè was really helpful and nice. He gave plenty of tips where to go or where to eat. This place has everything you need.
Très bon accueil, André très sympathique et de bons conseils, logement convivial et bien situé proche du vieux Porto
근처에 동 루이스다리 전망할수있는 공원도 가깝고 마트도있어서 좋았습니다~

Stanza piccola ma funzionale, purtroppo priva di finestre ma questo già lo sapevamo. Comodo per brevi soggiorni. Host impeccabile nel suo operato, disponibile e gentilissimo. Posizione comoda in Villa Nova De Gaia.

André was nice and facilitated the check in/out. The building is located close to Vila Nova de Gaia center. It has 2 common kitchens and bathrooms and a living room, all in good conditions.
The room although looks good, has no window and no ventilation mechanism, accumulating easily smells and getting hot. One of the nights we even though about sleeping in the balcony, but ended up sleeping with the door open and with a small vent pouring air into the room.
We don't recommend this room, but the other rooms in the building looked extremely well.
Eine schöne,  saubere Unterkunft in perfekter Lage. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Diese Unterkunft kann wärmstens empfohlen werden.

This is a great place to stay, especially if you have a lot to do or to see in the city, as it's really close to subway stations in Manhattan. It is very clean and quiet. If your intention is to stay for a long period of time or to "live like a local" while you're there, and as a result you may need cooking or laundry, make sure to let the hosts know so that they show you what you need to do (unless you already have all the information you need before checking in.)
Isabella and Niteyes are a young couple very welcoming, open-minded and friendly. They clearly want their guesses to feel comfortable and are ready to put in every effort in order to make that happen. They also have good advice about eatery around. Enjoy!

Isabella and her family are most gracious, welcoming and warm. They truly made me feel at home while still having my privacy. I felt pampered with the lovely space, the luxurious amenities and beautiful ambiance. It is peaceful, especially gazing out the window last night while it was snowing. Great time for my journaling. The heater can get the room quite toasty and you have the option to turn it off. I enjoyed great rest in this mini paradise. Isabella goes beyond the call of duty in wanting to make her guests feel comfortable. I am very grateful. The listing was described accurately and the room was even better than expected. It is immaculate, cozy and stylish. Isabella really anticipates the needs of her guests--like an international outlet charger. 
The neighborhood bustles with NYC energy.  I hear it's a true NY community. Cool to be away from the routine tourist traps, yet I was still close enough to get my fill. The subway is right outside the apartment--especially neat as it was cold and blustery during my stay. I was in TSquare and WTC in a jippy on the 1 train--a perfect train line that took me everywhere and anywhere. Super convenient to get an int'l data plan from T-Mobile downstairs from the apartment. Isabella recommended great eateries in the immediate area and the really cool Cloisters museum in the Tryon park that is 15 minutes from apartment. I even traveled to Brooklyn to see a friend and the 24hr train system is safe and filled with endless shows by street performers. The A train is close when needed to get to the airports, but I got the 1 train and transferred 1 stop to A to get me to port authority.  I know I wrote a tome, but the family took the time to deliver great care for me and I am very thankful.

In a nutshell, Isabella and her family get people! They get hospitality! They rock! Thank you guys for making my trip fun! And your daughter is such a bundle of joy!
Isabella's place is clean and cozy, and the family are very welcoming. This is the first time I'm using airbnb and it's a good experience
Great stay at her place. It was very clean just like what the pictures show. She provided towels, water, coffee, etc and was very hospitable in person. I'm going back there again!

Our stay at Isabella's was PERFECT for what we needed! Although it was the busiest weekend of the year, we were able to use the subway across the street with ease, and Isabella gave us stop by stop directions to anywhere we asked. She even gathered local info for us when we asked about the Times Square celebration and when to go! She was a gracious host, leaving us a cute bottle of champagne (New Years eve!), assorted juices, coffee and filtered water for our comfort. The bed and pillows in our room was so comfortable, and it was a spacious and comforting. Isabella let us check in a bit early due to or flight arriving earlier than expected, which was so helpful as we were exhausted! She also let us keep our bags in her apartment until we were ready to leave for the airport today. All in all - 100% recommend!

I WOULD HIGHLY SUGGEST THIS PLACE! Not only is it affordable, Isabella's place is one of the nicest! It has a homey feel to it, and it's pretty clean, and their family is just so hospitable. ❤ two thumbs up!

Isabella and family are totally awesome! She helped us from the moment we booked the room with every question we had. In fact, we arrived early around 10am and were exhausted from a redeye flight from California, and the room was not to be ready until 3pm. Isabella took it upon herself and upgraded us to the suite without any price hike. Now, that is service! My girlfriend and I were excited and so relieved that we can catch some zzzzz's before exploring this amazing city. The room is serene, super clean and so comfortable.  We loved the bed--we slept like babies. Isabella always anticipated our needs and checked in with us. The room came with beverages, chocolate and gourmet coffee and tea.  We also appreciated the keyless access to the apartment--so modern and cool. We felt like it was our own place and truly enjoyed our privacy. My goodness, how close can the metro station be...I mean only a few steps away to everywhere that matters in Manhattan. We truly enjoyed this uptown neighborhood in Manhattan, as it was raging with NYC energy and excitement. And we roamed all over the city. Not to mention, her daughter is absolutely adorable and playful. Simply put, we loved our first Airbnb stay in this lovely paradise with very warm, human service. Isabella, thank you. Below is our description both in Mandarin and Japanese.

仲の良いご夫婦と可愛い女の子のﾎｽﾄです｡とてもお優しく､困った時や質問なんかは電話やﾒｰﾙですぐに対応して下さいました｡部屋は清潔で静かで､駅からとても近く何不自由なく過ごせました｡ありがとうございました
 
住家十分友善,纽约地铁很复杂,她都一点一点地帮你解释清楚,十分耐心｡房子是外旧内心,日用品一应俱全｡出门三分钟就到地铁一号线｡房子周围有药房便利店,还有好吃的papa Johns｡总之,价格不高,服务质量很不错

This is my second stay at her place and will be going back in the future! It's quiet and clean, and next to the 1 line. The host is always so thoughtful and communicative to make sure I have everything I need.

PERFECT is my only comment!
The bed is comfy, and I was always touched by numerous homy elements at the house. Isabella is super communicative and considerate. You can also find a fish market and several convenience stores in the neighborhood. Thumbs up!
A regular at this point~ My go to place as always! Wonderful host.

This was the first time in New York for my brother and me and it was great! We were worried that the place was a bit far from the major attractions of the city but it has a subway just across the street and it was easy to go everywhere. We did not see Isabella very often but she was always reachable by phone or message and she helped us with all our questions. She was so nice and caring! 
Oh! Before I forget: the bed was soooo comfy which it's something I think everybody can appreciate when you are in a city that you want to know as much as you can... We walked a lot every day so it was wonderful to get home to rest in that bed (We fall in love with that bed! hahaha!)
Thank you for everything Isabella!! xx
I highly recommend this cozy apartment! Isabella is very nice and always ready to help. The room is cozy, clean and quiet! Everything is so perfect and makes me feel like I'm home!
Great place, location and hospitality!

Ella and her husband made check in and check out very simple and their listing was accurate. They always reply to messages very promptly, which was a great help. They are a 30 second walk from the 1 subway which goes to many tourist destinations. The room is private, and the bed is a full size, very comfy. There is also a full length mirror in the foyer. I would definetily recommend.

The place was very near a subway station! Ella is quick to respond and so communication would not be an issue. Place was clean and basic amenities were provided. Definitely provides tourists value for money.
Ella was a great host and the place is terrific! Highly recommend!

地点挺便利的,主要是离地铁站非常近,也比较靠近曼哈顿｡
周边有一些饮食店和小超市,所以吃喝也很方便｡这一带就是平民聚集的地区,不是那么清洁,但感觉挺热闹比较安全｡我们晃悠到晚上10点以后也没觉得有什么危险｡房间因为是小套间,因此空间挺够用｡公寓大门也有锁,所以进来了就觉得挺安心｡bnb主人回复很快,也会主动询问是否有需要帮助的｡整个入住体验还不错!

Amazing space, the room was charming and the bed super comfortable. The host was great and very helpful. It’s also an amazing location right by the subway and bus stops. The neighborhood is also amazing with plenty of amenities just doors away. You can’t go wrong booking here.

Even though I didn’t get to meet Ella, I felt I know her via phone and text convo. She communicated effectively and answered all  my questions promptly. The bed was comfortable and it felt like a private suit. The aminities were great. I recommend this Airbnb to everyone.

This place is amazing! I was so marveled at the set-up and beautiful decor. It was fantastic to have not just a room, but a little off shoot of a room as well connected to it, gave it a sense of luxury. Very comfortable bed. I slept like a lamb. A desk. Great lighting with a number of lamps. and the string lights made for a nice touch. In fact, there were tons of nice little touches throughout. The room even came with a fridge stocked with Voss water and sparkling flavored Izze drinks.  Soothing, calming chakra crystals all over the room too.  I didn't see my hosts at all beyond check-in because I left early and returned late every night for work. But they were always available.  Would def return.

Ella was extremely helpful with the tips for the area  and with checking in. She also loaned us an umbrella which was so appreciated. Be sure to keep your phone charged, because you must use an app to enter the apartment. The subway entrance is very conveniently located nearby as well as the Dunkin Donuts to grab a quick coffee or breakfast on the way out. There was supposed to be another guest in the apartment, but the way the place is laid out, we never saw them. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
I booked Ella's home last minute because the host of the Airbnb I had originally booked cancelled last minute.  Communicative, clean and cost effective, Ella's home was perfect for me!
It‘s a good living experience. Good location near the subway station

The apartment is right across the road from the 1 line and the A C trains were less than 10 mins walk away, which was amazing for quick and easy travel into the city. 
Great amenities and was very private - didn’t even notice there were others staying in the other room.
Check in was very easy and Ella’s husband was very welcoming and happy to give recommendations in the area and further. Ella was always available to contact. 
Would definitely stay there again.

Ella’s suite for guests is exceptionally beautiful. It is packed with amenities like refreshments, artisanal coffee and tea and natural products for bathing, even umbrellas. The room was immaculate, neat and aesthetically decorated. There were fine touches like see-through curtains that can be draped. There is ample space to hang clothes. Everything was beyond our expectations and we travel all over the globe. We are conscientious travelers and loved the value we experienced. It just felt so cozy, comfortable and warm. Yes, it is a stone throw away from subway. We got everywhere from either 1 or A trains. Let me tell you that Ella checks in to make sure we are happy. She is responsive, friendly and thoughtful. Seriously, you’d be a fool not to book this cute gem, where your needs are fully anticipated. She makes sure that we have the best possible journey no matter how tiny the problem. We look forward to returning. Thank you, Ella!
Cute place, a little far from downtown, but good with instructions on checking in and hospitality.  Her husband was really nice too!

The flat is very close to line 1 underground station (just across the street) and A express train (5 minutes by walking), which both head straight to downtow. A express train is also connected to Newark airport train through Penn station. The flat was very clean and tidy, the room extremely cozy and cute. Ella's husband gave us a very warm welcome and many suggestions about the city, communication with Ella was always easy and fast. We would definitely stay at their place again.

Ella's place is nicely decorated & very clean. The bed is good, we slept wonderfully in it! The shower was hot & the towels  super soft & comfy!! Ella and her husband are very helpful with local tips to eat. The neighbourhood is Spanish as a lot of Dominican people live there. That was a nice experience as well.
A good place. The transportation is convenient and host is very nice.

Expect a warm welcome, a comfortable bed and small touches to make you feel at home. I especially appreciated Niteyes helping me with my luggage. The family made the bathroom available almost all the time, which was both kind and amazingly generous. They have two cute (and very quiet) little girls. My room was charming and spacious, with a little fridge, a hot pot and coffee press. Mirrors, closet space, pretty and practical accent lighting. The kitchen was also available. Friendly, cheerful neighborhood. I would be glad to return!

Ella was a wonderful host. I loved the character and colorfulness of her place. The communication was clear and she made every effort to make me feel accommodated (and succeeded at it). I will definitely consider staying here again in a future visit to NYC.

Ella’s place was spacious and spotless. Everything I needed was provided, and the location is convenient to move around the city. Communication was easy, Ella is very responsive and accommodating. Definitely recommend!

Ella was a most hospitable host. My daughter and I spent 5 days at her place while we visited several colleges in the city. Since neither of us had ever been to New York before Ella was a great resource for navigating the subway system as well as recommendations on food and leisure activities. She responded very quickly to any messages! Not only is Ella a wonderful host, but clearly a lovely person. It was a pleasure to be in her quiet, clean and welcoming home.

Our trip to NY was awesome and a major part of that was thanks to Ella and her incredible home. Not only was it aesthetically pleasing, but it was as I called it “a spa away from home”. The energy was gracious and we actually looked forward to returning to our stay after eventful days. 

More pluses/reasons to stay:

It conveniently located next to the 1 train

There were mini libraries (from childrens  to self help)

Very spacious for two people (same to be said for the shared bathroom) 

Ella is a great communicator and left kind thank you notes

The lock system is super intuitive.

We will 1000% be looking to stay here again when we return to NY!

-Mayen

It was a pleasant stay since the day I checked in. I arrived late at night but Ella waited for me and ensured the check-in went smoothly. The bedroom was comfortable and tastefully decorated. The kitchen and bathroom were tidy and clean. Ella’s husband even got me a new rice cooker! When my kids arrived later, he got me new mattress and kids’ table. Her home was very child friendly too. My kids enjoyed the stay.Furthermore, the location is accessible to subway, restaurants, supermarkets and laundry service.They are great hosts and very accommodative.
I highly recommend her home to everyone who wants a cozy and memorable stay in New York.

Ella is a great host. Apartment is well maintained and fully equipped. My room was spacious, tastefully decorated and spotless. You will not get bored even you do not go out to explore New York, as there are plenty of books to read in the room. This is important, as New York weather can be bad at times especially during the winter season. We had our Year 2019 countdown with the host, as it was raining and cold on the New Year’s Eve. The audio-visual system was  superb. Who needs a hotel when you have a good host like Ella?☺

Angels was a very nice host.
Very helpful and flexible with the check in and out.
The location is really really good. So close to the beach and in the really cozy Barcelonetta.
The apartment is big, and can host up to 10 people.
It is very nice with 4 bathrooms.

I can definitely recommend this nice place.

This property comes highly recommended . We had the entire house which meant lots of space for the 6 of us . The kids enjoyed the wi-fi and the location was perfect for the beach , with lots of supermarkets , a full market and an amazing bakery a few steps away . Marketa met us as arranged and was generous with her time and gave us lots of  information about using the metro and local interests. We loved it and would loved to have stayed longer .

The apartment was everything I expected and more. Four of us stayed in the apartment and we all had a double bedroom with an ensure and air con each. The location was ideal as it is literally a 5 min walk from the beach and close to all transport links.

Maison parfaite ! Située en plein barceloneta, à 10min à pied de la plage, à 300m du métro barceloneta. Très pratique pour les soirées au bord de la plage, on était 5 et on avait tous assez de place pour chacun. 
Vraiment recommandé, rapport qualité/prix imbattable pour la période d'été.

This is an amazing townhouse apartment in a fantastic location. It is beautiful building, spacious, well equipped and clean. Angeles was very  helpful and responded quickly to requests. Upon arrival we were greeted by the lovely Marketa who told us everything we needed to know about the apartment and the area. I would not hesitate in recommending this to a large group or family looking to visit the incredible city of Barcelona. Thank you Angeles

Fantastica!! La casa è prorpio come è descritta: bella e spaziosa.  Quattro superfici autonome, ognuna con una camera da letto e da bagno.   Siamo stati accolti dalla carinissima Marketa che ci ha dato molti consigli sulla città.  La posizione della casa, a due passi dal mare e dalla metropolitana,  ci ha consentito di vivere il mare di Barceloneta, la parte più allegra e colorata di Barcellona e di raggiungere velocemente i luoghi più belli della città. Siamo stati molto bene, speriamo di tornarci presto.

The home was as described. Because I don't know Spanish, communication in English with Angeles via email seemed to cause misunderstandings at times. Marketa met us at the apartment at the appointed time and was super helpful. She arranged a taxi to the airport for our flight home when we checked in. She was very helpful with giving us tips about our visit. The apartment is in a great location, easy to get anywhere you want to go. It is also very spacious, spread out over 3 floors. FYI-the kitchen and laundry are on the top floor. Be prepared to do lots of stairs. The decor was very minimal and didn't feel very warm or inviting. The house is in mostly good repair. There is a washer, but no dryer. There are a couple of clothes drying racks provided. If you intend to do any cooking, the kitchen is not particularly chef friendly. It's tiny with essentials provided. There are no spices, etc. And no coffee pot. The mattress on the top floor is very hard. My husband loved it. I did not. I did not try the rest of them. But the kids didn't complain, so they must have been fine.
The host was very accommodating even allowing us an extra couple of hours before checking out

Great house, I'd fully recommend it and return in a heartbeat. Perfect location by the beach but close enough to walk into the centre. Lots of shops & restaurants nearby as well as a metro station. The house itself is brilliant, 4 stories with a bedroom and bathroom on each floor so it was ideal for us as 4 girls. Small kitchen to make food & really good air con individually controlled in each room. Really quiet steet plus wifi in the whole house. Completely smooth check-in with great communication from the host at all times and no problems during our stay at all, we'll be back!

Everything was great. We got very nice support from a very good English speaking host, which is not really common in Spain. Some technical issues where fixed very fast, the location is really good for either visiting the city or just hang around on the beach. Only the WIFI is a little issue, but only if you are in the apartment on the top. 

Thanks for everything!
We had a lovely stay at Angeles apartment!
Sehr schöne, gepflegte Unterkunft.
주변 자연환경과 생활여건(슈퍼마켓, 레스토랑, 자전거-스쿠터 대여점 등 다수), 교통여건(지하철, 공항행 기차, 다수의 시내버스 등)이 매우 뛰어남! 4층 구조로 각 팀간 독립성이 보장되나, 4층 주방으로 오르내리기가 다소 어려움.

A great place to stay. Perfect location with easy access to all the city and beach. With 8 people staying the kitchen and dining area was somewhat cramped eating breakfast and, on the odd occasion, lunch on our knees. That said it wasn't a problem. The ages ranged from 12 to 78 and the 5 flights of stairs became a little tiring after 3 days of walking! There was plenty of hot water for us all to shower before going out for the night with hairdriers and towels provided in each room. Marketa welcomed us with plenty of information and also booked taxis back to the airport. Would certainly recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona.

Situation géographique excellente entre le vieux Barcelone, la plage, le port. Très propre et spacieux, idéal pour petit groupe.
Réactivité pour les conseils et  accueil agréable.

Bon séjour à Barcelone, dans ce logement spacieux et très propre. Il y a une chambre ou 2 par étage (en tous 4 étages, avec beaucoup de marches), et la cuisine est au dernier étage. La literie est récente, mais il n'y a pas d'alèse sur les matelas et les oreillers. Les sanitaires sont très propres. L'environnement est calme, la rue est passante mais pas durant la nuit. La cuisine est minuscule, pas du tout adaptée pour 10 personnes, tout au plus pour 4. C'est vraiment le gros défaut de cet appartement.

Muy buena ubicación, muy buen servicio, muy buena zona - tranquila y cerca de todo!!!perfecto para grupos/ parejas!!!

Inconvenientes: limpieza pésima, 1 toalla de ducha para 4 días, sábanas, nevera y armarios sucios.

Volvería sin duda siempre y cuando la limpieza mejore!!!!!!
The apartment is very nice, perfect for big groups of family or friends. We had a great time there!

Nous avons été bien accueillis, le logement est tout à fait conforme à la description et très propre. Nous étions trois familles avec plusieurs enfants. La pièce commune n'est pas très grande, mais cela n'a pas posé de problème car chaque famille avait son espace avec sa propre salle de bain.
La maison est parfaitement située pour découvrir Barcelone.

We loved our stay at this property in Barceloneta. Everything was easy and straightforward. Good communication from Angeles our host throughout. We called through to Marketa from the airport who met us at the apartment to give us the keys once our taxi arrived from the airport - we loved Marketa, felt very welcome, and despite being regulars in the city, enjoyed her useful Barcelona advice! The apartment itself was brilliant, lovely and spacious, clean and fab central access to the city. We spent lots of time in Born which was no more than a 5 minute walk, but also had the chance to check out more of Barceloneta and the beach from this position which made for a really great trip. The neighbourhood itself, despite the occasional passing moped (standard!) was actually remarkably quiet considering the central location, and well lit. We also had luck on our side with 23C temperatures in the first week of Jan which made for a perfect visit! Thanks again, we would not hesitate to recommend this place or to stay there again in future.

This was a great place, great location, huge rooms, clean apartment. Everything just fit perfectly. Also really great if you're with a big group. We will definitely book this one again on our next trip to Barcelona :)!

We had an excellent stay at Angeles' place in a location you cannot beat in Barcelona. The walk down to the beach only take 5 min and you are in the middle of everything. The rooms were clean and beds were super comfy. There was more than enough space available as the apartment has 4 floors and numerous bathrooms. Thanks again for making our stay in BCN so memorable.
Host was very welcoming and made the process so easy. The place was amazing so nice all modern and clean. Kitchen was full as well. Great for a group of people looking to stay together.

Super schönes Haus in einem tollen Viertel. 
Obwohl wir mitten in der Nacht angekommen sind, wurden wir nett im Empfang genommen und durch das komplette Haus geführt.
Es war alles sehr sauber, die Betten war sehr gut und die Zimmer hell und ausreichend groß.
In der Küche ist alles vorhanden was man so braucht. Bei der Anzahl an Personen die im Haus platz haben, wäre aber eine Spülmaschine nicht verkehrt.
Barceloneta kann ich als Wohngegend nur empfehlen. Auf der einen Seite des sehr urigen Viertels gelangt man direkt zum Hafen, auf der anderen Seite zum Strand.
Und der Placa de Catalunya ist gerade mal 20 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt.
Es gibt viele nette und vor allem von Einheimischen besuchte Lokale in der direkten Umgebung und einen kleinen 'Groß'-markt zum Einkaufen.
Wer mehr Party möchte findet an der Hafenmeile immer etwas.

this location is exceptional, exactly matches the description, the neighborhood is full of bars, close to passaige de borbo ', asseggiata waterfront to Port Vell, near the Barceloneta metro and beautiful walks up the Ramblas from the Mirador de Colom, the house is aredata very well, spacious and clean, equipped of all the ' (Website hidden by Airbnb) room with attached bathroom, large kitchen to eat in gruppo.Noi we were 6 persons instead of 8 as we had planned, and we had available throughout the home. the house is spread over 4 floors where the interior staircase overlook the .Consiglio strongly rooms in groups, there torneremo.Marketa has been very clear in the information and available .Davvero congratulations to Angeles, for us a wonderful stay.
This is a fantastic apartment in an area that is close to the beach and close to the gothic quarter

We had an amazing weekend in Barcelona and this flat really fulfilled all our wishes. Great location, clean, no noise, great interior, nice bathrooms (not all too common in Spain!), and we also felt safe all the time. 
So if you consider having a great time in this awesome city, you are at right adress!

We got a very bad and rude welcome from the host due to her not reading the request properly and expecting less people and then accusing us of providing false information. We were shouted upon with rude behavior at 11pm in the night and not let into the house for a good while with all the kids and luggage just sitting on street. After argument were we allowed in the house and eventually stayed for the couple nights. Very bad experience from start. 
Also the space and house layout was not properly communicate from start and the host had multiple opportunity to realize we were 4 more people that she expected. 
In terms of the house, it is in great location very close to the beach and was clean and well maintained. 
The experience at check in was horrendous and stuck with us for the remainder of our stay and trip.

Everything was perfect.
The girl who assist as to the house was very helpful and friendly.
The house is very big, clean and had everything that we needed.
The location is just perfect, really close to the beach.
Bars, restaurants, super markets, metro station are really close to the house, making our stay easier.
It was the best choice for sure, i suggest it to everyone.
Everything ok. Good location and nice apartment.

This is a great place for a large group to stay. We had a lovely time in the flat and apart from a small issue with some broken furniture (which was quickly resolved) it was a great find. It is a brilliant location with supermarkets, bars, the beach and many other amenities nearby. Thanks very much Angeles!

The apartment and the location are really awesome. Everything was as described and shown on the pictures. 
Marketa gave us a very warm welcome and gave us a lot of tips for the area. 
I can definitely recommend this flat to any guest.
Tolle Unterkunft, nette Schlüsselübergabe, prima Informationsaustausch. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Angeles was very accessible.  Apartment is in good location.  I was not aware that the apartment is four rooms one above another without an area to come together as a family other than the kitchen area.  If you are staying in master bedroom, then it is just fine. I stayed in the room above and the ac did not work and is very small. WIFI very slow or not working and must constantly reset router.

Boendet var över vår förväntan! Lägenheten hade ett väldigt bra läge men i ett lite halvdåligt kvarter. Ca 500 m till stranden och mataffärer och allt annat låg precis utanför dörren, helt perfekt! Vi kommer definitivt åka dit igen!

Kjempebra leilighet å leie hvis man reiser flere sammen. Vi ble møtt av Markreta som var veldig hyggelig og kunne svare på alle spørsmål. Vi var 7 stykk og det var mer enn nok plass. 5 av 7 fikk egen seng. Sengene var gode og airconditionen var enkel å bruke og effektiv. Rommene var rene og ryddige. Gode håndduker. Kjøkkenet hadde alt man trengte. Leilighetens beliggenhet med et par minutters gange til både strand, La Rambla og det gotiske kvartalet var helt fantastisk. Vi var alle enige om at hit kunne vi reise tilbake og bo som dronninger!
Very nice place. We where very happy!

Our host was welcoming however overall we were disappointed in our stay. The house is smaller than expected and is arranged on 4 levels and exhausting hiking all those stairs after a day of exploring Barcelona. The washer is also broken and couldn't be fixed until "after we left". The shower head was also broken, but they did come fix that the next day. The showers are cramped but we did have enough hot water for 8 of us to take quick showers. The linens were well used and rough. I would not recommend staying here. It is affordable but I wish I would have invested a little more money to be more comfortable.

Our host made us feel right at home.  Check in was smooth.  Our host met us at the apratment and showed us each of the floors and discussed the surrounding neghborhood.  

The location is great.  It is near the beach, metro trains and walking distance to many restaurants and tourist sites.  There is also a nice grocery store and fresh food market nearby.

This house has the most perfect location. The owner is very nice. I went with my family of ten people and there were plenty of space for all of us. Two minute walk to the beach and two minute walk to the city. Will definitely come back again!
Great place in perfect location

This apartment is an absolute gem! We were a group of 7 girls on holiday to make the most of Barcelona and this apartment certainly made that possible. Location is great, right next to the beach but super easy to travel further into the city centre. Upon arrival Augusto welcomed us in and was extremely helpful! The apartment is 4 floors so it really felt like everyone has their own space and also enough communal areas for when we did come together. It was very clean and modern. Highly recommend this for any groups visiting Barcelona!!
Had a great time, accommodation is good, clean, Augusto was very welcoming and helpful.

Great building in a fantastic location. Check in was super-easy and accommodated our early arrival. Everything very clean. Communal space is as described - a little limited for large parties, but bedrooms are spacious. Would definitely stay there again.

This place is very clean and near of all accommodations ! 50m you have 2,3 supermarket. 50m you have two of the best tapas restaurant of Barcelona . 
After 5 minutes walk you are at the beach and the port. 15min walk you are at the begin of la rambla.
The host was very kind, he booked a taxi for our return, and explained all the house. 
I recommend this place. It a a good place to visit Barcelona ! 
Thanks a lot

Tuvimos una excelente semana en este departamento, es amplio, limpio y está bien ubicado. 
Angeles y Augusto nos ayudaron con lo que necesitamos y respondieron rápidamente.
Muy recomendado.

My friends and I stayed in Angeles' apartment while we were in Barcelona for a conference, and we had a great time! The apartment was clean and well-located - convenient to access with public transport, making it very easy to go anywhere. As it is close to the beach and to the main attractions, we were able to enjoy our time in Barcelona even though had to work all day.
Angeles and Augusto were very helpful and accommodating, and always responded promptly when we had questions.
We particularly liked the fact that we each had our own space, with separate bedrooms and bathrooms.

The House was very nice and situated in Barceloneta near the beach, Metro and good restaurants. The rooms were spacious and the kitchen perfect for our group (6 people). All the practicalites were taken care of in a very professional way. I highly recommend this house andet its owner.
Angeles was so helpful before arriving. We had such a great stay here!! The location was perfect. I would recommend this house highly. Thank you so much!!

Really great value! Nice and clean appartment on a superb spot in Barcelonetta. You can walk easily to the beach, restaurants, coffee and market are all a few blocks away. Also close to Gothic area. 
Small minor point are the bunk beds and the shower on the second floor.

Very clean apartment in very good location. Had a very friendly welcome which went smoothly. Well worth the cost. Only downside is the wifi is very slow (when working at all) but everything else very good.

I was visiting Barcelona on business with three other colleagues and the apartment was absolutely perfect for what we needed.

The location is great, with easy metro access (Barceloneta) and being extremely close to both the pier, the city centre and,as a consequence, great restaurants, shopping etc.

I would recommend this apartment for any type of visitor (business or pleasure) and you will not be disappointed.

The host (Angeles) and Augusto who let us into the apartment were great and very helpful.
Everything was as expected, good communication welcomed and given a tour of the house, even given a map highlighting local places to see along with good restaurants.
Host was very helpful. Location was great.

Abbiamo soggiornato dal 13 al 16 di ottobre. .....esperienza positiva....Angels molto precisa con gli appuntamenti e sempre pronta ad ogni consiglio. Ci ha accolto Augusto che ci ha fornito una mappa e molti punti di riferimento per muoverci a Barcellona. Noi abbiamo soggiornato un 10 ed è stato perfetto...anche la posizione in cui si trova ti permette di passeggiare sul lungo mare di Barceloneta molto frequentato oppure recarti facilmente sulla Rambla con una passeggiata di 10 (Website hidden by Airbnb) lo consiglio a tutti.....

Werkelijk een perfect huis voor een wat grotere groep reizigers (wij waren met 9 personen).
Iedere verdieping is ruim en biedt de privacy van een eigen badkamer.
Het huis is ook ideaal gelegen in de wijk Barceloneta. Tip: ga in Barceloneta eten en drinken in een van de buurtrestaurantjes, topkwaliteit voor een schappelijke prijs.
De verhuurster Angeles was ook zeer behulpzaam toen we onszelf een keer buitengesloten hadden op een van de verdiepingen, ze heeft toen telefonisch de oplossing doorgegeven.
Al met al een perfect verblijf, we maken graag een volgende keer weer gebruik van dit huis.

The Ceck Inn with Augusto was great, super nice Guy.
The House is big and well equipped. Everything was clean. The Location is perfect, close to the Beach and the City Center. We had a great stay and would come back for sure :)

Cette maison est située au coeur de la Barceloneta, à quelques rues de la plage, des commerces et d'un marché couvert.  Relativement grande pour le quartier, elle est très propre et le ménage est fait pendant le séjour.  La communication avec l'hôte est parfaite.  Les chambres sont bien équipées.  Il manque juste un peu de confort dans la cuisine (four, lave-vaisselle, verres à vin...).  Attention : Barcelone n'aime pas Airbnb et les voisins sont très rapides à accuser sans raison les hôtes de Airbnb.  Nous recommandons cette maison agréable dans un quartier pittoresque de Barcelone.
Piso genial!! Y muy bien colocado, lo aconsejo a todos! Dueños muy amables!

Angeles a pris soin que nous soyons accueillis dès notre arrivée. Notre hôte nous a donné de bons conseils pour visiter la ville et nous a bien orientés pour les détails pratiques (métro, où manger, etc...). Le logement est fonctionnel pour accueillir un groupe. Parfait !
Great place for smaller group!
Bon emplacement, Bon acceuil et très sympa sur les modalités de départ.

Ottima sistemazione per gruppi di persone dai 5 elementi in su. L'appartamento è strutturato su 4 piani ognuno dotato di ingresso autonomo e bagno. Solo quello al piano terra è dotato di cucina e divano letto. Anche se lo stabile è non è proprio di recente costruzione, gli appartamenti che ne sono stati ricavati sono tutti nuovi e ben tenuti. Anche se Angeles non è stata presente al momento del check in (erano passate le 12.00) è stata più che tempestiva nell'inviare una persona che potesse farlo al posto suo.
Un emplacement génial !

We were a group of 5 adults and 3 children aged 8, 10 and 13, and this house was just right for us. Great location, with a couple of very good restaurants near by, a taxi stand at stone's throw, metro station close by, convenience stores around the corner.....really, very easy indeed. We got great tips from the host's friend who showed us in.

Will definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona.
Good location, friendly host and a very big house

Very close to multiple restaurants. Spacious place, basically 3 apartments in one house. Our host was very helpful and knowledgeable of the surroundings and best places to eat and sightsee. There were 6 of us and we were more than comfortable in this space.

Excelente ubicación, muy recomendable para disfrutar de Barcelona.
Angeles es una anfitriona que no deja nada librado al azar, la propiedad es perfectamente adaptable a viaje en familia ó grupos
Très bien dans un quartier sympa, proche de tout !!

Una casa muy agradable y limpia con mucha independencia y cuatro baños .Muy buena ubicación cerca de cercanías estacion de Francia y cerca del metro también. Buena zona de bares y restaurantes. Muy cerca del mar. Gracias Angeles y Augusto por vuestra hospitalidad y por hacernos la estancia tan increíble.
Un emplacement parfait, une maison idéale pour un séjour entre amis, propre, bonne literie, rien à redire ! Un excellent séjour chez Angeles
Nice location, kitchen fully equipped. There is everything you need. Every room has its bathroom, very comfy

Great place! Clean and well equipped. Easy reach if metro to all areas of Barcelona ( very cheap)! Right by beach and food places. Lovely old Square behind apartment. Rooms excellent. Only wish is for a larger seating area - only a two seater sofa in kitchen, although there are plenty of chairs at the long kitchen table! No oven but has microwave and well equipped kitchen. Lovely place. Lots of stairs so may be difficult for elderly or disabled.

Great position for sightseeing and nightllife, very nice house,spacious and well organised; the neightbours are a little bit too sensible about noise, but we managed anyway.I can really recomend the house
Amazing place to stay! Super clean, tidy and full of all the main essentials. Great location and ideal for tourist locations
séjour parfait, à recommander !
Clean, cozy and conviniently located in Barcelonetta. During the daytime it's a bit noisy due to narrow streets proximity but not an issue after ten pm. 6 of us enjoyed our week stay.
Je recommande..

I have been to Nice several times and this apartment is the best location you could wish for.
Modern and clean.
Everything was fine on arrival.
I would certainly recommend this apartment to get a good and comfortable stay in Nice.
Estancia genial!!
Très bon emplacement. Logement propre. Nous sommes arrivés tardivement avec un accueil chaleureux et sympathique
The apartment is 4-stories which gave us lots of space. Cool old school neighborhood too and just a 5-10m walk to the main beach in Barcelona. Lots of restaurants in the area.
El lugar es amazing , súper súper limpio mis amigas encaradas , cerca de todo , restaurantes , taxis , buses , metro , lo recomiendo de corazón , quede enamorada gracias Angeles
Absolutely a pleasure! Big house that was centrally located in Barceloneta. Just a few minutes from the Subway, but we were able to walk to almost everything. Highly recommend to the family traveler.

Excellent & accurate communication, great location, perfect for our family of 6 people
Thanks to Angel and team

Great location, within walking distance of a number of restaurants, and bus stops.
Everything was clean, and plenty of privacy for everyone.
The beds were very comfortable.
A great house near the beach, the harbor and nice restaurants. Perfect for two families with children!

Angeles' place is in a great location and close to all transport links so getting around the city is easy. In 5 days we managed to do most of the sights. Neighbourhood was safe with lots of supermarkets and restaurants close by. Apartment was spacious and best of all, plenty of bathrooms. A highly recommended place to stay and would definitely try to stay there again on any future visits.

Thanks for being such a great host. Apartment was great and very spacious since we were only 4 guests. Would definitely book this one again!.

10/10
Grande maison idéale pour les groupes, très bien située (moins de 10 minutes à pied de la plage !). Logement conforme à la description, rien à redire sur la propreté.

This property is in an awesome location, we couldn't have asked to in a better place. A 5-10 minute walk to the beach, 5 minutes from the marina. It is also great if you want the hustle and bustle of being on the main road leading to the beach, and also the quite, quaint area behind it all. The quiet area behind the main road, had a host of local bars and restaurants that were mainly used by locals, and not filled with tourists. The property is to a great standard and all you could ask for on a short or longer break. The road was a little noisy, but nothing major. Angeles, the host was super responsive through the whole process and would highly recommend this as your next option when visiting Barcelona. All in all our stay was awesome! Thank you Angeles!
Central location and great for our group.
Underbar lägenhet med många badrum vilket är ett stort plus. 5 minuter till stranden och bra läge överlag. Perfekt helt enkelt!
Angeles place is really nice and great value
Perfect location, very clean, highly recommend
Best location and best place in BCN
For a group of young girls, this was amazing. Perfect location, right by the ocean and not a far walk from the clubs at all. Was perfect for holding as many girls as we were.
El apartamento es una finca entera y la verdad es q es muy cómodo y muy bien ubicado. Hemos dormido muy bien y la comunicación con Angeles ha sido muy fluida.
Wir waren ein paar Nächte in der Wohnung und wir haben es sehr genossen. Es ist eine tolle Wohnung die ich gerne weiterempfehle.

This place is perfect for a large group traveling together!  Angeles was very good at communicating and had someone meet us to give us keys and instructions.  The place is a four flat....large comfortable kitchen and a full bathroom on the walk in Street level.  Another large bedroom on second floor with full size bed and full bathroom.  Lots of closet space and a pull out twin.  Go up another flight to the third floor for another bedroom with a full bed and full bathroom, plus another room with 2 twin bunk beds.  From here take another flight to the final room with room for 3 to sleep plus another full bathroom.  Very clean, convenient to shops, restaurants and a short walk to Barceloneta Beach and the harbor.  Nice linens, towels, blow dryers Nd air conditioned.  No beach towels so either bring your own or a beach blanket (they also sell these on the each for 20€. ).
Perfect Location and a very nice apartment for a friendly stay !

Gutes kompaktes Haus in zentraler Lage zum Hafen, Metro, Bars und Nightlife. 
Sauber und ordentliche IKEA Einrichtung ohne Abnutzungserscheinungen.
Klare Empfehlung wer über das Wochenende eine einfache Unterkunft für bis zu 8 Personen sucht.
Ótima estadia

Very nice stay and a great location.  The kids loved going to the beach after a long day of touring.  Just be sure to ask the host directions to the beach before they leave.  There is no information or maps in the apartment but markets, restaurants, metro are all within walking distance once you get your bearings.

Angeles's was not available to meet us upon arrival and our host kept 9 of us waiting for 20 minutes outside on the narrow sidewalk with our luggage in the heat; even though we called him an hour before when we arrived at the train station.  That was not a great introduction and we were nervous we were not in the correct location.  However, Angeles was great communicating before and during our stay.  

The kitchen does not have an oven but does have a two burner stove top and microwave.  We mainly ate pasta while there so it worked out fine.  The stairs do get a bit tiring but for the size of our group, the privacy it provided and the apartment location, it worked out fine.  One bath and hand towel is allotted per person for the length of stay so you need to buy/bring beach towels.  There is no dryer so you really need to plan when washing towels.  The washer takes about 2 hours for a cycle and drying time is a day on the drying rack.  

Overall, a nice stay!
Good location and communication but there were some problems with the naighbours
Great location close to Barceloneta beach. Clean and well equipped apartment. Perfect for a large group

This place is amazing. Great location, and very attentive host. I would highly recommend it. Close to the beach and all other tourist attractions.
Lots of great food around as well.

God plassering i byen i forhold til serverdigheter og strand. Fint for venner.  Skulle gjerne hatt en uteplass/terrasse, da eneste mulighet for å samles var på kjøkken på gatenivå. Men det var flere restauranter i område , hvor man kan sitte ute. Alt i alt meget godt fornøyd.

This is a wonderful, large, flat central to everything you could possibly want in Barceloneta! Has everything you need and can sleep a very large group. Angeles was very easy to work with. Would love to stay here again.

A bunch of friends and I spend three nights at Angeles's place, and it's great in every way. The location is amazing, right in the middle of La Barceloneta, in walking distance to the old town as well as the beach.

The place was clean, and the neighborhood was reasonably quiet at night.

Tips for the neighborhood:
- Tapas at Bar Bitácora were our favorites, it's just around the corner.
- The bread and pastries at Forn Baluard were amazing. Perfect for any meal, and the bread goes incredibly well with good serrano or jamon.

Alloggio molto carino ed accogliente, super consigliato sia per l'ottima ospitalità avuta da Angeles sia per l'ottima posizione, a pochi passi dal mare e vicinissimo alla Metro :-) 
Provare per credere!!!

Das Haus befindet sich Nahe dem Hafen in sehr zentraler Lage. Alles ist mit dem öffentlichen Nahverkehr oder zu Fuß erreichbar. 

Insgesamt ist alles in einem sehr guten Zustand. Lediglich geringe Abnutzungen an den Wänden. 

Nette und unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit Augusto.

If you going to Barcelona for the beach this is the right place to be! 
The apartment was really nice

Die Unterkunft ist zentral zwischen Strand und Altstadt gelegen. Wir wurden total freundlich durch Augusto begrüßt. Er hat uns die Unterkunft gezeigt und noch einige nützliche Tipps zur Umgebung gegeben. Die Unterkunft ist sauber und gut ausgestattet.

The apartment was as advertised.  It worked out great for the 6 of us.  We stayed four nights.  The location is great.  Walking distance to the beach, to the hop-on hop-off buses, and the subway.  Plenty of bars and restaurants in the area.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and our visit of Barcelona.  I recommend this apartment.

This lovely house is situated in the heart of the old town, Barceloneta. It is less than 5 minutes walk from the marina and from the beach, both of which have great bars and restaurants. La Ramba is a half hour walk away, but a taxi costs just €7 and will have you there in five minutes. There are bars, restaurants and small supermarkets in the old town itself.
The house is made up of 3 separate units plus a large kitchen and bathroom on the ground floor. The first floor has a good sized double bedroom and ensuite bathroom. The second floor has the same layout as the first, but also has an additional door off the landing. This leads into a large living room with a bunk bed and balcony and a staircase to the third floor. The third floor has a large lounge with a single bed and balcony, plus doors leading to another double bedroom and a bathroom with a washing machine.
The house was spotlessly clean with plenty of towels and all the beds had new sheets and bedspreads. There were extra blankets should you need them, but we didn't. All areas have their own air conditioning and heating. The kitchen has all the crockery and utensils you could need, large fridge with freezer compartment, electric hob and oven and microwave.

When we go back to Barcelona this will be the place we would want to stay again.

Angeles' location is conveniently located near shopping, groceries, and lots of restaurants in a vibrant part of town.  Check in was easy, check out a breeze but hard for me personally as I fell in love with the city during my stay.  Would definitely stay here again and recommend to friends and family.
Great place for large groups. Its an entire building with a double room and bathroom on each floor. Highly recommend. Thank you!

Great place! It was perfect for our group. Close to the beach and anywhere further we caught the public transport or walked which was easy. Was a great base for us and there was plenty of space. Having 4 bathrooms was a bonus. Host was friendly and helpful. Would stay again and recommend. Thank you.
Le logement est très bien situé et bien aménagé . Nous avons pu nous déplacer très facilement dans la ville avec les différents moyens de transports.A recommander
Thank you for a lovely weekend! We enjoyed getting out and about and see this beautiful city! Thanks for being so kind and letting us stay!
Great place in a great neighboorhood. The rooms were large, all have their own bathroom, a comfy bed. Restaurants, supermarket, taxi's and the beach were all very close.
非常干净,非常安静,位置好,离海滩近,早上起来跑步去沙滩也方便,入住方便,可住十人,有四个卫生间,这个非常好｡还会推荐给朋友
Perfect location, had a lot of fun in Barcelona, definitely recommend :)
Gran estancia, ideal para un grupo de amigos. Buena ubicacion, veracidad, comunicacion y limpieza. Altamente recomendable
Très bon appartement, bien placé.
The place was wonderful, perfect rooms, clean, well situated next to the beach, close to shops and restaurants, really close to the metro station. This is definately your place!
amazing location. practical house.
Este lugar para viajar en grupos es excelente. La localización es de las mejores, cerca de muchos lugares para comer y “walking distance” de muchos lugares por ver.

Angeles place is great if you are looking for a larger place with a central location. The flat is located in the heart of Barceloneta, and the walk to all the main sights was a very easy distance. The place was perfect for a group of 10 of us and we all slept very comfortably. The only struggle we had was with the wifi but it was very trivial because we were out and about! Thanks for the great stay!

Appartement très propre, bien équipé et très bien situé. 
Appartement idéal pour une grande famille ou un moment entre amis!
Angeles et Augusto ont été aux petits soins pour nous. Ils ont su répondre à nos attentes et questions quand nous en avons eu besoin.
Appartement que je recommande sans aucun doute!!!
Merci pour tout!

A lovely and very clean... It was better than hotels I've stopped in.. It's so close to the beech and caters for everything, lovely restaurants, everything you need to explore... Everything was walking distance...
The host canceled this reservation 488 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

I really enjoyed Angeles place. It was big enough for my all of my family and friends. 4 floors all to ourselves. 
It was very local to everything. 5-10min walk to the beach, las ramblas, and other fun areas. 
I totally would recommend this place to anyone.
War super.
Lots of space, good location and value.
Apartment was clean, comfortable and in a good location. Angeles was helpful. Thanks.
We had a very good stay at Angeles! The house is perfectly located, very convenient for large groups and Angeles shared great tips about Barcelona. It has been a pleasure

The stay was very nice and comfortable! The house is spacious with enough showers and bathrooms for 6 or more people. The location is super central with all shopping possibilities. The hosts are very polite and friendly and are helpful throughout the stay! Definitely would recommend for anyone and for my own next visit as well!

Fabulous location within walking distance to lots of restaurants, the marina, the beach and the metro.  The apartment has everything you need and ample space and facilities for lots of people! Highly recommended - Cannot fault at all.
We had 2 families (ten total) and the bed spaces worked out great. Very walkable to many restaurants/cafes and sights!

A good fit for our group of six adults and a child with room to spare.  Communication was prompt and helpful.  Wonderful location a few blocks from the water.  Lots of stairs, but we didn't find it to be a problem.

L'appartamento è in una posizione fantastica, a due passi dalla fermata di Barceloneta, vicinissima al mare, al Born, al barrio Gotico e anche al Parc de La Ciutadella. Camere spaziose, letti molto comodi, arredate con gusto e con tutto il necessario. Zona silenziosa, ma servitissima allo stesso tempo. 
Noi viaggiavamo con bambini piccoli e Angeles è stata molto gentile nel farci trovare un seggiolone e un lettino da campeggio. 
Assolutamente consigliato, ottimo rapporto qualità-prezzo.
The house is as described. Everything you need is provided. The communication goes easy. Baceloneta is a great place to stay, right in between the old city and the sea.

Great apartment with plenty of space for our 7 people (and we could have fit more). A quick 15 or so minute walk to all the places we wanted to see - La Rambla, Casa Batllo, Casa Mila, Sagrada Familia, The Gothic Quarter... or easy to access an Uber or Taxi. Great restaurants right nearby. Angeles was quick to respond to all my questions as well. Great stay!

The host is communicative and easy to reach. The building has several rooms divided on 4 floors with the kitchen on the bottom. It was a good setup for me and my friends but of course optimal had been if it was many rooms on the same floor. We used the building mainly for used  sleep over since there is no good hangout area like a terrace (small  balconies only) - only a kitchen with hard to reach sunshine. Overall: I highly recommend the building for bigger groups who wants to have a cleen and central place to sleepover at.

The house is situated in the perfect place when you want to explore Barcelona and enjoy the beach.
Angeles made sure everything was sorted and thought of additional things like shampoo is the showers.

This place was fantastic.  We stayed with two families with infants and three single adults and there was enough space for all of us to have our own little spaces and then to convene in the communal kitchen.  Barceloneta is a fantastic neighborhood, lots of restaurants, close to the beach and the metro.  This is great for a bigger group that would benefit from some private spaces for individuals or families.  There is a high-chair and porta-crib which was wonderful for our 9 month old.
Location location location!   Lots of space for extended family or group of friends.  Also lots of stairs but the multiple sleeping options great bonus.  Nice balconies and 4 full bathrooms great
Perfect appartement in an absolutely perfect location. The owner was very kind and helpful. We had the BEST stay and would love to go back!

This appartment is rather basic, nothing fancy. Each room is on a seperate floor. It sufficed, was clean, communication was about the best we ever had in Barcelona. It is a matter of taste but for us the location was great.
This property is perfectly located in the seaside area with access to everything you could want. Modern well appointed property with heaps of room for our 2 families of 10 people.
Perfect accomondation gor big groups or familys. Superb location close to the beach

Angeles is incredibly helpful, quick to respond and beyond that her space is amazing.  It was very spacious, high quality, safe and only about a 5min walk to the Barceloneta metro.  There are plenty of things to explore within a short walking distance and comfortable to lounge around in if you don't want to go out.  Each floor is a different room, so do be prepared for stairs (kitchen on the ground level, then  4 more floors beyond).  Would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment is in a great location, close to many restaurants, the beach, and the metro. It was a great space for our group, having a washing machine was very nice. The apartment is spread over 4 levels, so there are a fair amount of stairs, but no trouble for us. Communication was fast and easy. I would recommend staying here.
Great location and beautiful big house.

Ich schreibe eigentlich keine Bewertungen, aber dieses Mal muss ich einfach :) 
Ich kann das Haus wirklich nur empfehlen! 
Wir waren aufgrund eines Junggesellinnenabschieds von Freitag bis Montag in Barcelona und waren 8 Mädels - die ideale Größe für dieses Haus. Wie in der Beschreibung mitgeteilt, sollte man allerdings ab 22:30Uhr wirklich leise sein. Das haben wir bemerkt, als 3 Mädels abends vor der Tür eine rauchen waren und sich unterhalten haben, da haben sofort die Nachbarn an die Wand geklopft - man darf aber auch in der Küche/Aufenthaltsraum rauchen. Ansonsten waren wir abends/nachts nicht im Haus, sondern feiern ;-) 
Der Kontakt mit der Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich. Auch der Check-In sowie Check-out war einfach und unkompliziert! Das Haus ist sehr sauber und hat an Ausstattung einfach alles, was man benötigt. Die Lage ist top...der Strand, sowie Supermarkt und Restaurants/Bars sind um die Ecke. Ich würde die Unterkunft sofort wieder buchen!
Great location.
Perfecta localización, y gran equipación del alojamiento

The location couldn’t have been better for us! Only a 5-10 min walk to the beach & metro, and very close to local markets and many restaurants. The space is well equipped for cooking on the main level, next level up is the master suite with fold out couch, followed by floor with 2 rooms (1 with bunk beds and the other with double bed), top floor includes 2 rooms (1 twin and 1 double)- each level has full bath. There are 3 sets of keys available for the house, each set including main door key plus individual room key. There is not a safe present on-site, but still your passports & cash are safer here than on your body. Pick-pocketing is a HUGE problem in this city!

We were 9 girls and had I nice stay at Angeles apartment. The apartment is close to the beach, about 5-10 mi walk, and also really close to grocery shops. 20 minutes walk to the shopping street Las Ramblas, or you can take the metro situated 200 meters from the house, for 5 minutes. The apartment is perfect for 3 families who wants to stay together, or a group of friends. There is no living room in the apartment, but that was not really a big problem, because there was a big table in the kitchen. The neighbors were really sensitive the first day, because 9 girls living together make a lot of noise, but after a conversation with angeles everything went fine, and we didn't here more from the neighbors. So if you want to be noisy after 22.30, this apartment is not for you. The best thing about the stay was the easy communication with angeles. She answers fast, and does not hesitate to help you.

Realmente nos decepcionó el trato brindado por la anfitriona, siempre se contactó solamente a través de mensajes de la aplicación, que tardan demasiado en llegar y dificultan la comunicación. No nos permitió ingresar al alojamiento hasta las 11 PM que estuvimos los 9 huéspedes, violando las normas de Airbnb y lo pactado en la publicación. This home is just lovely! Better than I'd hoped in regards to getting away from our busy week for a much needed peaceful weekend. I would highly recommend this AirBnB! Thank you!

Absolutely beautiful home! Mike was very responsive and accommodating during our stay. I would recommend his home 100% to others. It’s a great location and the neighbors are wonderful!
Very nice place.  We all enjoy to stay in the beautiful house of Michael.  Everything and more was just perfect even when it rains.  I recommend this place!

This home and grounds are absolutely gorgeous. Very comfortable. It included everything we needed. We would highly recommend this house.

Beautiful atmosphere, secluded but not too far away from everything. The house was beautifully decorated and very clean. My favorite part was the outside garage/entertaining area. it was a nice comfy stay and id love to stay there again!

Beautiful home with every amenity you could dream of. Well stocked kitchen, washer/dryer, good quality beds...everything was wonderful. I can’t wait to come back again!

Very nice place, clean, quiet, well-equipped and confortable. Very nice hosts. I absolutely recommend this place.

Our stay was wonderful! The apartment is charming and well equipped, the building is beautiful and this area of Santa Teresa is perfectly located near night life of Lapa and buses to other parts of Rio. Eduardo & Raimundo were perfect hosts and the champagne for New Years was lovely!

Eduardo and Raimundo are very friendly and nice guys. They helped us with everything we needed. Even though it was only one night we enjoyed Santa Teresa. Thank you guys!

Eduardo & Raimundo are the perfect hosts in every way.  Communication, prior to and during our stay was excellent.  Nothing was too much trouble for them and they made sure that our stay was as comfortable as possible.  They are also very passionate about the local community and it's fantastic culture.  They provide us with lots of useful information and recommendations about places to visit based on our discussions with them (we managed to communicate easily despite our limited Portuguese). 

The apartment has been decorated and furnished in an imaginative way, making very good use of the space available and is very comfortable and light.  We felt very much at home immediately.  The hosts also added little touches which made us feel very welcome, including some provisions e.g. fresh fruit and drinks.  There is also a large external terrace area where you can sit and relax, with great views of Santa Teresa and the surrounding area.

The accommodation is located on a quiet street within 5 minutes walk of both the centre of Santa Teresa and Lapa, which both have plentiful bars, restaurants, galleries and other cultural sights that can be explored.  Public transport, both bus and metro, is easily accessible in Lapa, as too are taxis.  

We felt very safe within the area and would recommend the studio as a great base for exploring Rio.  

If we return to Rio, we would definitely stay at the studio and we will stay in contact with Eduardo & Raimundo, who are exceptionally generous hosts, who we now regard as friends.

Eduardo and Raimundo provided us with the best hospitality we had in the whole 2 weeks of being in Brasil for the world cup!
